## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository

No HTTP server, controllers, OpenAPI/proto files, RPC or CLI API in the repo; the app is an Android client. Only Android system integration exists: HOME intent on `MainActivity`, `PinItemActivity` for pin requests, `DeviceAdmin` receiver and `MyAccessibilityService` (AndroidManifest.xml). Outbound only: GET of `Constants.URL_WALLPAPERS` in `getTodaysWallpaper`.
